limitations: The replay outcome was decoded before this adapter path was implemented; this is a retrospective regression, not a blind prediction.
The replay does not serialize its engine-code version. Resource-151 is the calculation build, not a proved recorded engine build.
Only the selected first-hit pre-hit damage is compared. Its attached state grant, later hits, full card use, defense and encounter outcome are not validated by this check.
No account, player, replay key, card-instance or role-instance identifier is published.
